The unmodified `novnc-v1.6.0-vnc.html` fixture was downloaded from the official
noVNC v1.6.0 tag: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/novnc/noVNC/v1.6.0/vnc.html

It reproduces the actual upstream inline module bootstrap, including whitespace,
for the native-browser CSP regression. Its LF line endings are pinned in
`.gitattributes`. The exact bootstrap SHA-256 (base64) is
`/9PPJp0RDtPobChVxkPiMU+aOqJaic/KxxORSdYVFHE=`.

The upstream HTML retains its copyright notice and is licensed under BSD-2-Clause.
The corresponding unmodified upstream license overview and BSD-2-Clause text
are provided alongside it, from the same release tag:

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/novnc/noVNC/v1.6.0/LICENSE.txt
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/novnc/noVNC/v1.6.0/docs/LICENSE.BSD-2-Clause
